about.title: Hi, I'm Mauricio Correa.
body: A graphic and web designer with more than a decade of experience turning ideas into striking, functional visual experiences.
My goal is to help you tell your story through design, with solutions that reflect your brand's unique identity and connect with your audience in a meaningful way.
